title: 第2章 处决
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
老福特效率很高。

    不过两个小时，城堡前的巨大广场上就聚集了近三千领民。

    伊森站在城堡主楼的阳台上，俯视着下方黑压压的人群。

    人群边缘，城堡卫队维持着秩序，孩子们被母亲抱在怀里，踮着脚尖往广场中央张望。

    广场中央，二十三名囚犯被铁链拴成一串，跪在石板地上。

    他们衣衫褴褛，头发蓬乱，有的低着头瑟瑟发抖，有的则梗着脖子，脸上带着麻木的绝望。

    伊森一路走到广场中央。

    “少爷。”领地卫队长卡尔迎上来，右手抚胸，“一切都准备好了。”

    伊森点点头，目光从那排囚犯脸上扫过。

    二十三人，高矮胖瘦各不相同，但眼神里都透着相似的东西。

    恐惧、绝望、或者认命般的空洞。

    他收回目光，看向人群。

    近三千领民聚集在广场上，人头攒动，却出奇地安静。所有人都看着中央这位年轻少爷，等待着他开口。

    伊森没有多说什么废话，只是对卡尔点了点头。

    卡尔会意，转身对身旁的书记官挥了下手。

    书记官上前一步，展开手中的羊皮卷轴，清了清嗓子，高声念道：“今日，里奥家族继承人伊森·里奥少爷，十六岁生辰之际，特此处置领地内积压重犯，以正律法！”

    “带第一人，托马斯·克劳德！”

    两名卫兵从囚犯队列中拖出一个中年男人，把他按跪在广场中央一块专门清理出的空地上。

    书记官翻开另一张羊皮纸，高声念道：“托马斯·克劳德，原领地南境磨坊主。去年秋收后，因贪图邻户汉斯家的三袋麦子，夜间潜入其家中，用铁锤砸死汉斯夫妇，包括他们年仅七岁的幼子。次日伪造现场，谎称盗匪所为。后经调查，在其磨坊地窖中找到血衣和赃物。按领地律法，杀人偿命，判处斩刑！”

    人群里顿时响起一阵骚动。

    “这个畜生！”

    “汉斯一家多老实的人啊，他就下得去手？”

    “连孩子都不放过，该杀！”

    伊森缓步走向那个叫托马斯的犯人。

    托马斯跪在地上，浑身发抖，嘴里含混不清地嘟囔着：“饶命......少爷饶命......我是一时糊涂......我......”

    伊森没有理会他的求饶，目光落在他脖颈处。

    他抬起右手。

    旁边卫兵立刻递上一柄双手大剑，剑身沉重，刃口闪着寒光。

    伊森接过剑。

    剑一入手，一种奇异的感觉瞬间涌遍全身。

    重量、重心、开刃角度、挥砍时的最佳轨迹......所有这些信息仿佛本能一般浮现在脑海中。他甚至能感觉到，这一剑下去，应该以什么样的角度、什么样的力道，才能最干净利落地斩断颈椎。

    这就是武器大师。
content_en:
The old Ford was very efficient.

    In just two hours, nearly three thousand citizens gathered in the huge square in front of the castle.

    Ethan stood on the balcony of the main building of the castle, looking down at the dark crowd below.

    At the edge of the crowd, the castle guards maintained order. The children were held in their mother's arms and stood on tiptoes looking toward the center of the square.

    In the center of the square, twenty-three prisoners were chained in a row and kneeling on the stone floor.

    Their clothes were in rags, their hair was disheveled, some had their heads lowered and were shivering, while others had their necks stiffened, with numb despair on their faces.

    Ethan walked all the way to the center of the square.

    "Young Master." Territorial Guard Captain Karl came forward and put his right hand on his chest, "Everything is ready."

    Ethan nodded, his eyes scanning the faces of the row of prisoners.

    Twenty-three people, all different in height, short, fat, and thin, but they all had similar things in their eyes.

    Fear, despair, or the hollowness of resignation.

    He withdrew his gaze and looked at the crowd.

    Nearly three thousand citizens gathered in the square. It was crowded but surprisingly quiet. Everyone looked at the young master in the center, waiting for him to speak.

    Ethan didn't say much nonsense, and just nodded to Karl.

    Karl understood, turned around and waved to the clerk beside him.

    The clerk took a step forward, unfolded the sheepskin scroll in his hand, cleared his throat, and read loudly: "Today, on the occasion of his sixteenth birthday, Master Ethan Leo, the heir to the Leo family, hereby dispose of the backlog of felons in the territory to rectify the law!"

    "Take the first man, Thomas Cloud!"

    Two guards dragged a middle-aged man out of the prisoner queue and kneeled him down on a specially cleared space in the center of the square.

    The clerk opened another piece of parchment and read aloud: "Thomas Claude, a miller in the southern part of the original territory. After the autumn harvest last year, he sneaked into his neighbor Hans' house at night and smashed him to death with a hammer because he coveted three bags of wheat from his neighbor Hans' house. The Hans couple, including their seven-year-old son, faked the scene the next day and lied about the crime. After investigation, blood clothes and stolen goods were found in the cellar of their mill. According to the territorial law, they were sentenced to death by death. "

    There was a sudden commotion in the crowd.

    "This beast!"

    "The Hans family are such honest people, so he can do it?"

    "Even the children are not spared, they deserve to be killed!"

    Ethan walked slowly towards the prisoner named Thomas.

    Thomas knelt on the ground, trembling all over, mumbling indistinctly: "Spare my life... Master, spare your life... I was confused for a moment... I..."

    Ethan ignored his plea for mercy, his eyes falling on his neck.

    He raised his right hand.

    The guard next to him immediately handed over a two-handed sword. The sword was heavy and the blade shone with cold light.

    Ethan took the sword.

    As soon as the sword was in hand, a strange feeling instantly surged throughout his body.

    Weight, center of gravity, blade angle, optimal trajectory when slashing... all this information comes to mind like instinct. He could even feel the angle and force at which the sword should be struck in order to cut off the cervical vertebrae most cleanly.

    This is the weapons master.
